facts: The non-vacuous successful-delete fixture and physical-record assertion were approved.
Both deletion overloads capture active history before invalidation.
Failure retains finalized history with a receipt; success clears history without restoring the snapshot.
Revision barriers prevent late history writes from resurrecting a deleted conversation.
No blocking defect was found in the scoped diff.

residual_risks: Foreign README and installation artifacts must remain outside the scoped commit.
Queen and mesh publication remain a separate portable-release gate.
